hazards.evidence: Frequently used cookware, canned goods and food packages are stored on the floor/lowest shelf, requiring deep bending (unsafe after hip/knee replacement).
Pots, pans, cast-iron skillet and piles of cans/food sit on the floor along the left side, narrowing and cluttering the main walkway a walker must use between the shelves and counter.
Everyday dishes, bowls and glassware are stacked on the upper open shelves above shoulder height, requiring overhead reaching.
